verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 definition ('Secureframe API') and a rendered REST reference with request/response schemas at api.secureframe.com/docs, backed by a dated versioning policy. However, the spec is only embedded in the roughly 490KB page source. No separate raw-spec download URL is documented, so an agent has to scrape or extract it rather than download it. missing for 10: a documented direct download URL for the raw OpenAPI JSON/YAML, independent or hands-on confirmation that the extracted spec is complete and usable.
